review.body: { if proposal . recipe != PROPOSAL_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } let content = received (id , content_pre_digest , ProfileError :: Representation) ? ; check_host (host_content_blinding_value) ? ; content_from_checked (id , proposal , host_content_blinding_value , content) }
